entities.summary: Dzmitryj Wajciuszkiewicz (b. 1971-07-20, Byarozawka) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Byarozawka and Belarus. Known in the fields of belarus, composers & musicians, europe.
